correctness.rationale: For a queried support S={i_1<...<i_s} without both endpoints, every prescribed coordinate labeling gives interior switch totals of fixed parity in each gap; at least one exterior edge makes the attainable totals the entire integer interval [d,M]. Alternating queried labels force k>=s-1 and gap-parity-opposite labels force k<=n-s. The endpoint XOR equals k mod 2, forbidding the pair {1,n}. Singletons by complement symmetry and empty support settle boundaries. Partition matroid truncation gives all coefficients; the online upper bound follows from 2*C(n-1,k) hypotheses and independent threshold blocks give k floor(log2 floor((n-1)/k)) lower bound. A separate direct exhaustive computation verified 8,192 supports through n=9, but not infinite n.
